2025-08-18.riddle: I carry all your daily things and hang on straps so wide; with zips and pockets I keep all tucked inside. You wear me on your shoulders as you go— what am I?
2025-08-18.hint: I hold books and gear while you travel.

2025-08-19.riddle: I’m always moving forward, yet I never walk. I can be measured but not held, and I carry you from yesterday into tomorrow. What am I?
2025-08-19.hint: You can see me on a clock, but never touch me.

2025-08-20.riddle: I have hands but no arms, a face but no mouth. I keep you on track but never speak a word. What am I?
2025-08-20.hint: You look at me every day to stay on schedule.

2025-08-21.riddle: I can be cracked, made, told, and played. I can make you laugh or groan. What am I?
2025-08-21.hint: Sometimes I’m funny, sometimes I’m corny.

2025-08-22.riddle: The more you take from me, the bigger I get. What am I?
2025-08-22.hint: I grow as you dig deeper.

2025-08-23.riddle: I’m tall when I’m young and short when I’m old. I live only while I eat. What am I?
2025-08-23.hint: My light fades the longer I live.

2025-08-24.riddle: I’m always in front of you but can’t be seen. What am I?
2025-08-24.hint: You can think about me, but never see me.

2025-08-25.riddle: I fly without wings, I cry without eyes. Wherever I go, darkness follows me. What am I?
2025-08-25.hint: I bring both shade and storms.
